notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's ScrollTemplates.xml is shared plumbing (the faux-scroll kit and the real-scroll/clip kit: scrollbar slider, arrow buttons, wheel bubbling, offset math). MSUIClient realizes the same affordances through its own ImGui framework rather than as a surface: DrawVanillaScrollBar (keybindings), the SkillFrame scrollbar with arrow buttons/knob/track-drag law (SkillFrameUiLaw), quest-panel clip + wheel scrolling (QuestFrameUiLaw.ClampScroll), and per-panel paging where the reference pages (loot). No standalone counterpart is expected.
